releaseTitle: TikSave Ultimate Creator Suite v1.1.0 (Final Release)
releaseNotes:
• YouTube to Facebook Reels Clipper: Extract any YouTube link & format directly ready to post as 9:16 Facebook Reels
• Facebook Video Downloader to TikTok & Shorts: Convert any Facebook video into high-retention clips for TikTok FYP & YouTube Shorts
• Complete Resolution Support: 8K Ultra 120FPS, 4K HDR+ 60FPS, 1080p Full HD, 720p Normal & 480p Low Fast
• AI Viral Studio 2.0: Unlimited dynamic captions & hashtags with multi-variation generator (Viral, Comedy, Story, Aesthetic)
• 1-Tap Direct Sharing to Facebook Reels, TikTok & YouTube Shorts
• Android 14/15/16 Scoped Storage MediaStore gallery integration with zero EPERM errors
